assumptions: An honest local operator, kernel, SQLite, canonical verifier and synthetic signers. Caller and target are separate processes under one UID. The operator controls both ledger and checkpoint storage.
limits: Finite local scenarios with fresh keys per run. The observations cover pending synthetic intents; settlement, cross-UID custody, external anchoring and production operation remain unqualified.

controls.title: Concurrent duplicates and exact retry
controls.hypothesis: Concurrent copies of one valid dispatch could create multiple intents.
controls.inputs: Two identical initiation calls, then one sequential retry.

controls.title: Conflicting request ID
controls.hypothesis: A separately signed amount change under an existing request ID could replace its original intent.
controls.inputs: Original owner-approved dispatch followed by a freshly owner-approved dispatch for 4,501 fictional minor units using the same ID.

controls.title: Lost reply across restart
controls.hypothesis: A dropped response could cause reconciliation to redispatch an intent.
controls.inputs: Send once over the local socket, close before reading, restart the target and reconcile twice.

controls.title: Repeated historical verification
controls.hypothesis: Rechecking a signed historical receipt might change the stopped target ledger or create another intent.
controls.inputs: Verify one newly recorded synthetic intent concurrently twice without a running target.

controls.title: Expired grant at a live target
controls.hypothesis: A valid signature over an expired permission might admit a current dispatch.
controls.inputs: An exact grant with its entire validity interval in the target clock’s past, then an authorized positive control.

controls.title: Historical signature after revocation
controls.hypothesis: An authentic retained receipt might reinstate authority after the target owner revokes the grant.
controls.inputs: Recheck the historical signature and send a current operation under its revoked grant.

controls.title: Historical auditor at a live target
controls.hypothesis: A valid signed grant for the published historical auditor might authorize a new payment.
controls.inputs: The genuine audit inquiry grant from the Lab 001 archive, used in the current fictional grant slot.

controls.title: Older target ledger with retained checkpoint
controls.hypothesis: A stopped target could accept the prior ledger despite a newer retained local head.
controls.inputs: Two genuine snapshots from the same disposable target and its unchanged post-intent checkpoint.
